name: YuXin Little Magic 3x3 V3 (MagLev)
description: The classic gets a major boost with the V3 upgrade! Featuring a MagLev tension system and 6 center travel adjustments, this cube delivers precision engineering for a customizable, top-tier solving experience. With excellent corner cutting right out of the box and smooth, consistent performance, it’s ready to impress from your first turn.
